thread.title: Apple's iPhone boost; Weight Watchers signs DJ Khaled; McDonald's named top pick

title: Apple's iPhone boost; Weight Watchers signs DJ Khaled; McDonald's named top pick
text: January 2, 2018 Welcome to the first trading day of 2018. Shares of McDonald’s ( MCD ) are popping after Nomura named the fast-food chain its top 2018 U.S. restaurant stock pick. Analysts also raised their price target on the stock by $10 to to $190. Weight Watchers ( WTW ) shares are surging over 5% today after the diet program appointed DJ Khaled as a social media ambassador. He joins the ranks of Oprah Winfrey, who is a board member and part-owner of the company. Disney ( DIS ) received an upgrade to outperform at Macquarie. Shares are 1.7% higher as “Star Wars: The Last Jedi” became 2017’s highest-grossing movie. Apple ( AAPL ) stock is getting a New Year’s boost. That’s after Wall Street analyst Piper Jaffray maintained an overweight rating and confirmed its expectation that 2018 iPhone sales will carry the stock higher to their $200 price target. Rent-A-Center ( RCII ) shares are sinking after CEO Mark Speese announced his resignation amid the company’s plan to explore strategic options. Speese will be succeeded by former president Mitchell Fadel. Reblog
